pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. Farm fields at Kartarpur by the river Ravi in the 1530s, at evening: villagers harvesting and tending cattle; far away among them, an old man in a simple robe and turban works the land, seen only from behind, small in the wide landscape. Gold light over green fields, peaceful. The old man is Guru Nanak and is seen only from directly behind or very far away: no face, no profile, no cheek, no partial face is ever visible.
